artist.name: BAAWRA
artist.bio: Baawra is Hiten Mutreja, a Pune DJ and a core member of the MAUSHI collective. His sets lean on understated, hypnotic minimal techno. He played DGTL India in 2025 and recorded Wild City #264 in 2026.

eras.sound: Understated, hypnotic minimal techno with morphing melodies
